neighboring_unit_entries.title: Residue-kernel design makes the alternating zeta series summable under an integral
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Starts on the critical line, chooses x^4+n^2 so residues generate n^{-1/2-ib} while unwanted factors cancel, uses a closed alternating rational sum, and reinterprets complex b to extend the resulting integral to 0<Re(s)<2.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Expanding sinh(y)-y converts the integral into shifted zeta values and Gamma factors
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Rewrites the kernel so its Taylor series can be integrated termwise with a standard sinh integral, obtains a series of Gamma(2n-s+1)zeta(2n-s+1), and analytically sums the zeta-free part to isolate a convergent correction identity.

related_synthesis_entries.limit: This is a within-source interpretation of the displayed kernel, not a uniqueness statement about possible integral representations.
